hints.tr: İki doğru/yanlış değer hazırla: `inputs_changed = old["code"] != new["code"] or old["data"] != new["data"]` ve `model_changed`.
hints.en: Prepare two true/false values: `inputs_changed = old["code"] != new["code"] or old["data"] != new["data"]` and `model_changed`.

hints.tr: Dört durum bu iki değerin dört birleşimi: ikisi de `False`, yalnızca biri `True`, ikisi de `True`.
hints.en: The four cases are the four combinations of these two values: both `False`, only one `True`, both `True`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def review(old, new):
    inputs_changed = old["code"] != new["code"] or old["data"] != new["data"]
    model_changed = old["model"] != new["model"]
    if not inputs_changed and not model_changed:
        return "nothing"
    if inputs_changed and not model_changed:
        return "retrain"
    if model_changed and not inputs_changed:
        return "unknown model"
    return "ok"


old = {"code": "c1", "data": "d1", "model": "m1"}
print(review(old, {"code": "c1", "data": "d1", "model": "m1"}))
print(review(old, {"code": "c1", "data": "d2", "model": "m1"}))
print(review(old, {"code": "c1", "data": "d1", "model": "m2"}))
print(review(old, {"code": "c2", "data": "d1", "model": "m2"}))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

    if model_changed and not inputs_changed:
